units.title: Money: recognise coins and use £ and p symbols

lessons.title: Recognise and understand the value of different coins
Solve problems including those involving giving change

misconceptions.text: Children think a bigger coin is worth more, rather than reading its value
Children mix up the pound and pence symbols or write both together, such as £1.20p
Children count coins in the order they lie or skip count when the coin value changes
When finding change children split both numbers and subtract tens and ones, getting the wrong answer
